about_the_game:
Homelander’s Valor is a 2D tower-defence with hands-on tactical unit control and a day-night survival loop. Build your defences, command your troops, and join the fight in a mythic Eastern realm where every decision shapes the battle.

Key Features

  • Build Anywhere – place towers, barricades, and workshops exactly where your strategy demands; no fixed sockets.

  • Modular Towers – pick a base weapon, then slot elemental effects to forge unique combos and battlefield roles.

  • Day/Night Cycle – scout, gather, and expand by day; defend two flanks in tense real-time combat at night.

  • Hands-On Tactics – issue orders and redeploy instantly via an interactive mini-map, or dive in as the hero to turn the tide.

  • Mythic Eastern Atmosphere – artefacts of power, symbols of honour, and foes born of darkness; you defend a banner, not just a base.

  • Playable Demo – experience several full day-night cycles, experiment with every tower type and effect, and feel the strategic depth before launch.
